---
name: feature-planning
description: Use when starting a new feature. Walks through the planning steps from issue to approved plan before any code is written.
---

# Feature planning

1. Restate the feature request in the issue in two or three sentences and ask
   the requester to confirm.
2. List the screens, services and storage the feature touches.
3. Write acceptance criteria as observable behaviors.
4. Estimate in half days; anything above three days is split into smaller
   issues.
5. Post the plan as a comment on the issue and wait for the team lead's
   approval before opening a branch.
